correctness.rationale: Both W maps have affine full-union cell branch images; uniform conditional positions within cells are preserved by independent map choices and arbitrary finite cell histories. Thus stationary symbolic itinerary is Markov with four-row kernel P=[E;C;C;E], E=(1/a,(a-2)/(2a),(a-2)/(2a),1/a), C=(1-p+p/(a-1),p(a-2)/(2(a-1)),p(a-2)/(2(a-1)),0). Its two-state outer/central factor has theta=(a-2)/a and eta=p(a-2)/(a-1), stationary center alpha=theta/(1-eta+theta) and r=eta-theta. Direct symbolic multiplication independently confirms P²=1pi+r(P-1pi); this implies P^n=1pi+r^(n-1)(P-1pi), r vanishes only when p=(a-1)/a. Then P²=1pi yet P≠1pi, ensuring strict one-dependence of whole past and future Markov blocks, while center/outer is iid Bernoulli theta. Otherwise Cov(H0,Hn)=alpha(1-alpha)r^n nonzero for all n, excluding any finite dependence radius. Symbolic identities are exact; the Markov conditional-history argument supplies the infinite-time conclusion.
